working_definition: Author cell type 'photoreceptor' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult proboscis and maxillary palps, 494 cells): generic photoreceptor cells. Authors' term FBbt:00005162 'photoreceptor' is a light-sensitive sense organ (structure).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron that reacts to the presence of light.

justification: The authors' term is a sense-organ structure; the cell-level equivalent of a generic photoreceptor is the FBbt light-sensitive neuron (parent of eye photoreceptor cell, ocellar retinula cell, eyelet and Bolwig organ photoreceptors). No narrowing to eye photoreceptor cell, since the authors give no subtype or location.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Photoreceptor cell of the compound eye.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: More specific than the authors' generic label.
